name: Folded Masjid
summary: An angular dome and a slender minaret turn a mosque into a small architectural sculpture.
why: A few broad planes give the dome a folded silhouette. The open entrance and separate minaret keep the mosque readable, while a genuine gap between roof planes carries the fold into a one-color mark.
risk: The angular dome feels deliberately contemporary; viewers who prefer familiar curved mosque architecture may find it less immediate.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque with a distinctive contemporary silhouette.

palette.name: FOLDED MASJID / DEEP TEAL + IVORY + COPPER
